sec.title: Master Undated Resolution Pipeline (Batch 3 of 1,607)
sec.p: Continuing **Stage 1** of our systematic backlog resolution across all 80,308 undated broadcasts, **Batch 3** resolves another **50 broadcasts** from Edward R. Murrow's *This I Believe* on CBS Radio (Sequences 266 through 315).
This cohort brings forth historic voices in international diplomacy, human rights, the American stage, civil liberties, and grassroots public service.
